verses: O thou, accomplished, great Hou-chi, To thee alone 'twas given To be, by what we trace to thee, The correlate of Heaven. On all who dwell within our land Grain food didst thou bestow. 'Tis to thy wonder-working hand This gracious boon we owe. God had the wheat and barley meant To nourish all mankind. None would have fathomed His intent, But for thy guiding mind. Man's social duties thou didst show To every tribe and state. From thee the polished manners flow That stamp our land "The Great."
